conditions: Customer has at least one product in the cart
Customer proceeds through all checkout steps (cart → billing address → payment method → confirmation)
items.expected: No sign-in page appears at any step; the order confirmation page is displayed

conditions: Customer is signed in with a profile that has a saved address
Customer reaches the billing address step of checkout
items.expected: The billing address form is displayed with fields pre-filled; the customer's profile address data is shown in those fields

conditions: Customer is signed in with a product in the cart
Customer selects cash on delivery as payment method
items.expected: Payment is accepted; the order confirmation page is displayed

conditions: An unauthenticated user attempts to navigate directly to the checkout URL
items.expected: The checkout page is not accessible; the user is redirected away from the checkout URL

conditions: The checkout page is loaded while signed in
Axe-core scans the checkout form with rule tags wcag2a and wcag2aa
items.expected: No axe violations are reported for rule IDs in wcag2a and wcag2aa on the checkout page

conditions: Customer is signed in with a profile that has a saved address
Customer reaches the billing address step of checkout
items.expected: The billing address fields are pre-filled with the customer's profile address; the form is not empty
